40006585.author: पदार्थः
40006585.content: वीर्यवान् heroic, रामः Rama, भीमबलम् of terrific strength, राक्षसम् demon, तं विराधम् that Viradha, वने in the forest, हत्वा on killing, ततः thereafter, सीताम् Sita, परिष्वज्य embraced, समाश्वास्य च connsoled, दीप्ततेजसम् glowing like fire, भ्रातरम्  brother,  अब्रवीत् said.

40006585.author: Translation
40006585.content: On killing Viradha, the demon of terrific strength, heroic Rama embraced Sita, consoled her and said to his brother Lakshmana, glowing like fire:

40006586.author: पदार्थः
40006586.content: इदम् this, दुर्गम् wild, वनम् forest, कष्टम् is difficult, वनगोचराः uracquainted, न च स्मः we are not, शीघ्रम् quickly, तपोधनम् to the sage, शरभङ्गम् Sarabhanga, अभिगच्छामहे we shall go.

40006586.author: Translation
40006586.content: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult  to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.

40006587.author: पदार्थः
40006587.content: राघवः Rama, शरभङ्गस्य Sarabhanga's, आश्रमम् hermitage, अभिजगाम ह reached, देवप्रभावस्य of divine grace, तपसा by penance, भावितात्मनः had realised his self, तस्य शरभङ्गस्य that Sarabhanga's, समीपे  nearby, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful phenomenon, ददर्श saw.

40006587.author: Translation
40006587.content: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

40006588.author: पदार्थः
40006588.content: राघवः Rama, शरभङ्गस्य Sarabhanga's, आश्रमम् hermitage, अभिजगाम ह reached, देवप्रभावस्य of divine grace, तपसा by penance, भावितात्मनः had realised his self, तस्य शरभङ्गस्य that Sarabhanga's, समीपे  nearby, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful phenomenon, ददर्श saw.

40006588.author: Translation
40006588.content: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

40006589.author: पदार्थः
40006589.content: वपुषा with his body, विभ्राजमानम् shining, सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम् like the Sun or the fire, रथोत्सङ्गात् from the the lap of the chariot, अवरुह्य descending, आकाशे in the sky, विबुधानुगम followed by the gods, विबुधेस्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), वसुधाम् earth, असंस्पृशन्तं without touching, सुप्रभाभरणम् adorned with shining ornaments, विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम् wearing pure white clothes (that never got soiled), तद्विधैरेव like him, बहुभिः many, महात्मभिः by great souls, पूज्यमानम्  worshipped, देवम् deity, विबुदेश्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), ददर्श witnessed.

40006589.author: Translation
40006589.content: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

40006590.author: पदार्थः
40006590.content: वपुषा with his body, विभ्राजमानम् shining, सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम् like the Sun or the fire, रथोत्सङ्गात् from the the lap of the chariot, अवरुह्य descending, आकाशे in the sky, विबुधानुगम followed by the gods, विबुधेस्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), वसुधाम् earth, असंस्पृशन्तं without touching, सुप्रभाभरणम् adorned with shining ornaments, विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम् wearing pure white clothes (that never got soiled), तद्विधैरेव like him, बहुभिः many, महात्मभिः by great souls, पूज्यमानम्  worshipped, देवम् deity, विबुदेश्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), ददर्श witnessed.

40006590.author: Translation
40006590.content: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

40006591.author: पदार्थः
40006591.content: तस्य from that place, अदूरतः not far from, हरितैः by tawnycoloured, वाजिभिः by horses, युक्तम् yoked with, तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् shining like the rising sun, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यम् comparable to a palewhite cloud, चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम् shining like the lunar orb, अन्तरिक्षगतम् found in the sky, रथम् chariot, ददर्श witnessed.

40006591.author: Translation
40006591.content: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

40006592.author: पदार्थः
40006592.content: तस्य from that place, अदूरतः not far from, हरितैः by tawnycoloured, वाजिभिः by horses, युक्तम् yoked with, तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् shining like the rising sun, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यम् comparable to a palewhite cloud, चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम् shining like the lunar orb, अन्तरिक्षगतम् found in the sky, रथम् chariot, ददर्श witnessed.

40006592.author: Translation
40006592.content: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

40006593.author: पदार्थः
40006593.content: विमलम् pure white, चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम् decked with variegated flower garlands, छत्रम् umbrella, अग्य्रे  in the forefront, रुक्मदण्डे golden staff, महाधने very costly, वरनारीभ्याम् by two excellent women, गृहीते held, मूर्धनि near the head, धूयमाने fanning, चामरव्यजने  'Chamara' made of yak's tail, अपश्यत् saw.

40006593.author: Translation
40006593.content: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

40006594.author: पदार्थः
40006594.content: गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च celestial musicians, gods and siddhas, बहवः many, परमर्षयः great sages, अन्तरिक्षगतम् stationed in the sky, देवम् deity, अग्य्राभिः by choicest, वाग्भि: with words, ईडिरे praised.

40006594.author: Translation
40006594.content: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

40006595.author: पदार्थः
40006595.content: वासवे Indra, शरभङ्गेन with Sarabhanga, सह सम्भाषमाणे was conversing with, तत्र there, शतक्रतुम् Indra, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

40006595.author: Translation
40006595.content: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

40006596.author: पदार्थः
40006596.content: अथ then, रामः Rama, रथम् chariot, उद्दिश्य pointing at, अद्भुतम् wonderful one, भ्रातुः brother, प्रदर्शयन् while showing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अर्चिष्मन्तम् effulgent, श्रिया with grace, जुष्टम् endowed with, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रतपन्तम् shining, आदित्यमिव like the Sun, अन्तरिक्षगतम् in the sky, रथम् chariot, पश्य see,

40006596.author: Translation
40006596.content: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

40006597.author: पदार्थः
40006597.content: अथ then, रामः Rama, रथम् chariot, उद्दिश्य pointing at, अद्भुतम् wonderful one, भ्रातुः brother, प्रदर्शयन् while showing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अर्चिष्मन्तम् effulgent, श्रिया with grace, जुष्टम् endowed with, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रतपन्तम् shining, आदित्यमिव like the Sun, अन्तरिक्षगतम् in the sky, रथम् chariot, पश्य see,

40006597.author: Translation
40006597.content: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

40006598.author: पदार्थः
40006598.content: पुरुहूतस्य of Indra who is often invoked, शक्रस्य of Indra, ये those, हयाः horses, नः for us, पुरा earlier, श्रुताः heard, ते those, हरयः horses, अन्तरिक्षगताः stationed in the sky, दिव्याः wonderful, इमे we, ध्रुवम् surely.

40006598.author: Translation
40006598.content: The horses of Indra, who is often invoked (during sacrificial rituals) and about whom  we have heard earlier, are now stationed in the sky.

40006599.author: पदार्थः
40006599.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.

40006599.author: Translation
40006599.content: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

40006600.author: पदार्थः
40006600.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.

40006600.author: Translation
40006600.content: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

40006601.author: पदार्थः
40006601.content: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.

40006601.author: Translation
40006601.content: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

40006602.author: पदार्थः
40006602.content: प्रियदर्शनाः men of delightful counterance, इमे these, पुरुषव्याघ्राः best of men, यथा as, दृश्यन्ते they are   seen, एतत् this way perhaps, देवानाम् for gods, वयः age, नित्यदा always, constant भवति किल remains verily.

40006602.author: Translation
40006602.content: These tigers among men have cheerful countenacess from which it can be deduced that the age of the gods always remains constant.

40006603.author: पदार्थः
40006603.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वैदेह्या सह along with Sita, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, इहैव here itself, तिष्ठ stay, यावत् until, अहम् I, रथे chariot, एषः this person, द्युतिमान् shining with brilliance, कः (इति) who he is, व्यक्तम् clearly, जानामि I know.

40006603.author: Translation
40006603.content: Lakshmana, stay here with Sita awhile, until I ascertain who this dazzling being on the chariot is.

40006604.author: पदार्थः
40006604.content: इहैव here only, स्थीयताम् stay, इति thus, तं सौमित्रिम् to that Lakshmana, उक्त्वा having said, काकुत्स्थ: (Rama) of Kakutstha family, शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति to Sarabhanga's hermitage, अभिचक्राम  went.

40006604.author: Translation
40006604.content: Instructing Lakshmana to wait , Rama  went towards Sarabhanga's hermitage.

40006605.author: पदार्थः
40006605.content: ततः then, शचीपतिः husband of Sachi (Indra), समभिगच्छन्तम् coming towards him, रामम् to Rama, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, शरभङ्गम् Sarabhanga, अनुप्राप्य having reached, विविक्ते in private, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

40006605.author: Translation
40006605.content: Then Indra (husband of Sachi) having seen Rama coming towards him, approached Sarabhanga and said this to him privately:

40006606.author: पदार्थः
40006606.content: असौ oh, इह here, उपयाति coming near, यावत् until, माम् with me, नाभिभाषते he does not talk, तावत् in the mean while, निष्ठाम् to some other place, नयतु take me, ततः wherefrom, मा not, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हति is fit, जितवन्तम् victorious one, कृतार्थम् one who acomplished his task, इमम् him, अहम् I, अचिरात् in a short time, तदा then, अनेन not possible, अन्यैः for others, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कर्तव्यं हि remains to be accomplished.

40006606.author: Translation
40006606.content: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.

40006607.author: पदार्थः
40006607.content: असौ oh, इह here, उपयाति coming near, यावत् until, माम् with me, नाभिभाषते he does not talk, तावत् in the mean while, निष्ठाम् to some other place, नयतु take me, ततः wherefrom, मा not, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हति is fit, जितवन्तम् victorious one, कृतार्थम् one who acomplished his task, इमम् him, अहम् I, अचिरात् in a short time, तदा then, अनेन not possible, अन्यैः for others, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कर्तव्यं हि remains to be accomplished.

40006607.author: Translation
40006607.content: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.

40006608.author: पदार्थः
40006608.content: इति in this way, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, वज्री Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, तं तापसम् that ascetic, आमन्त्र्य taking leave, मानयित्वा honouring, हययुक्तेन yoked with horses, रथेन in his chariot, दिवम् heaven, ययौ went.

40006608.author: Translation
40006608.content: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.

40006609.author: पदार्थः
40006609.content: सहस्राक्षे the thousandeyed Indra, प्रयाते having departed, राघवः Rama, सपरिच्छदः along with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana), अग्निहोत्रम् fire altar, उपासीनम् sitting by the side, शरभङ्गम् Sarabhanga, उपागमत् approached.

40006609.author: Translation
40006609.content: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

40006610.author: पदार्थः
40006610.content: रामः Rama, सीता च and Sita, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तस्य Sarabhanga's, पादौ feet, सङ्गृह्य prostrated, लब्धवासाः on getting seats to sit on, निमन्त्रिताः invited, समनुज्ञाताः responding to the instruction, निषेदुः sat down.

40006610.author: Translation
40006610.content: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana prostrated at Sarabhanga's feet. After being permitted to sit, they were invited to stay there.

40006611.author: पदार्थः
40006611.content: ततः then, राघवः Rama, शक्रोपयानम् reason for Indra's arrival, पर्यपृच्छत् enquired, शरभङ्गश्च Sarabhanga also, तत् सर्वम् all that, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् narrated.

40006611.author: Translation
40006611.content: Thereafter on Rama's query Sarabhanga told him all about Indra's visit:

40006612.author: पदार्थः
40006612.content: राम O Rama, एषः this god, उग्रेण severe, तपसा austerity, जितम् attained, अकृतात्मभिः  by those who have not realised their self, दुष्प्रापम् most difficult, ब्रह्मलोकम the world of Brahman, माम् myself, निनीषति wishes to take me.

40006612.author: Translation
40006612.content: O Rama, Indra, the bestower of boons, wants to take me to the world of Brahma,  earned by me through severe penance which is most difficult to be attained by those devoid of selfrealisation.

40006613.author: पदार्थः
40006613.content: नरव्याघ्र O best of men Rama, अहम् I, प्रियातिथिम् a very dear guest, त्वाम् you, अदूरतः nearby, वर्तमानम् present, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, ब्रह्मलोकम् world of Brahma, न गच्छामि I will not go.

40006613.author: Translation
40006613.content: O Rama, the best among men you are a very dear guest to me and knowing that you are near, I will not go to the world of Brahman without seeing you.

40006614.author: पदार्थः
40006614.content: पुरुषव्याघ्र O best of men, अहम् I, धार्मिकेण by a virtuous one, महात्मना by a great soul, त्वया by yourself, समागम्य after meeting, देवसेवितम् abode of the gods, त्रिदिवम् heaven, गमिष्यामि I will go.

40006614.author: Translation
40006614.content: O Rama, the best of men  (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.

40006615.author: पदार्थः
40006615.content: अक्षया imperishable, नरशार्दूल O best men, मया by me, शुभाः auspicious, ब्राह्म्याः pertaining to Brahma's, नाकपृष्ठ्याश्च  pertaining to heavenly abode, लोकाः worlds, जिताः are conquered, मामकान् all of them belonging to me, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept.

40006615.author: Translation
40006615.content: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)

40006616.author: पदार्थः
40006616.content: ऋषिणा by the sage, शरभङ्गेण by Sarabhanga, एवम् in that way, उक्तः said, नरव्याघ्रः great Rama, सर्वशास्त्र विशारदः knower of all sastras, राघवः Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40006616.author: Translation
40006616.content: To these words of sage Sarabhanga Rama, the best of men, the knower of all sastras, the scion of the Raghus replied:

40006617.author: पदार्थः
40006617.content: महामुने O great sage, अहमेव I myself, सर्वान् all, लोकान् worlds, आहरिष्यामि will acquire, तु you, अहम् I, इह here, कानने in the forest, प्रदिष्टम् directed, आवासम् reside, इच्छामि intend.

40006617.author: Translation
40006617.content: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

40006618.author: पदार्थः
40006618.content: शक्रतुल्यबलेन equal to Indra in strength, राघवेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः said, महाप्राज्ञः sagacious, शरभङ्गः Sarabhangha, पुनरेव once again, वचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40006618.author: Translation
40006618.content: To this request of Rama who was equal to Indra in strength, sagacious Sarabhanga said these words:

40006619.author: पदार्थः
40006619.content: राम O Rama, इह here, अरण्ये in the forest, महातेजाः briliant, धार्मिकः righteous, नियतः selfcontrolled, सुतीक्ष्णो नाम Sutikshna by name, वसति resides, सः he, ते to you, श्रेयः wellbeing, विधास्यति will look to.

40006619.author: Translation
40006619.content: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama

40006620.author: पदार्थः
40006620.content: त्वम् you, शुचौ in a sacred, देशे place, तपस्विनम् an ascetic, सुतीक्ष्णम् Sutikshnam, अभिगच्छ you may approach, सः he, रमणीये in a delightful, वनोद्देशे in the forest, ते to you, वासम् dwelling, विधास्यति will provide.

40006620.author: Translation
40006620.content: You may approach sage, Sutikshna residing in a sacred spot. He will provide you a delightful place for your stay in the forest.

40006621.author: पदार्थः
40006621.content: राम O Rama, स पुष्पोडुपवहाम् carrying flowers and floats, इमाम् this, मन्दाकिनीम् river Mandakini, प्रतिस्रोताम् against the current, अनुव्रज follow, ततः then, तत्र there, गमिष्यसि you will reach.

40006621.author: Translation
40006621.content: Proceed, O Rama  in the reverse direction of the river Mandakini carrying flowers and floats. And you will reach the place.

40006622.author: पदार्थः
40006622.content: नरव्याघ्र O best among men, एषः this is, पन्थाः path, तात dear child, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, माम् me, पश्य you may see, यावत् meanwhile, जीर्णाम् wornout, त्वचम् slough, उरगः serpent, इव like that, गात्राणि limbs, जहामि I will shed off.

40006622.author: Translation
40006622.content: O Rama, the best among men, this is the way. Look at me for a while, my dear, until I shed my limbs just as a snake sheds its withered slough.

40006623.author: पदार्थः
40006623.content: ततः then, महातेजाः effulgent, सः शरभङ्गः that Sarabhanga, अग्निम् fire, समाधाय after kindling with faggots, आज्येन with ghee, मन्त्रवित्  knower of magical spells, हुत्वा च after offering oblations, हुताशनम् into the fire, प्रविवेश entered.

40006623.author: Translation
40006623.content: Then the effulgent Sarabhanga, knower of mantras (magical spells) kindled the fire with faggots and after offering oblations of ghee plunged in.

40006624.author: पदार्थः
40006624.content: तदा then, वह्निः the fire, महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, रोमाणि hair on the body, केशांश्च hair on the head, जीर्णाम् worn out, त्वचम् skin, तथा similarly, अस्थीनि bones, यच्य whatever, मांसम् flesh, सशोणितं च along with blood.

40006624.author: Translation
40006624.content: Then were consumed that highsouled Sarabhanga's hair on the body and on the head, the wornout skin, the bones and flesh along with blood.

40006625.author: पदार्थः
40006625.content: सः शरभङ्गः that Sarabhanga, पावकसङ्काशः shining like fire, कुमारः youthful, समपद्यत became, तस्मात् from that, अग्निचयात् from that heap of fire, उत्थाय after emerging, व्यरोचत looked splendid.

40006625.author: Translation
40006625.content: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

40006626.author: पदार्थः
40006626.content: सः that Sarabhanga, आहिताग्नीनाम् of those who offer oblations to fire, महात्मनाम् of the great souls, ऋषीणां च of the sages, देवानां च of gods, लोकान् worlds, व्यतिक्रम्य after going beyond, ब्रह्मलोकम् world of Brahma, व्यरोहत ascended.

40006626.author: Translation
40006626.content: Sarabhanga then went beyond the worlds of the gods, of the great sages who constantly kindle sacrificial fire, and ascended to the world of Brahman.

40006627.author: पदार्थः
40006627.content: पुण्यकर्मा performer of sacred deeds, सः that, द्विजर्षभः best among brahmins, भुवने in the world, सानुचरम् with his followers, पितामहम् Brahma, ददर्श saw, ह verily, पितामहश्चापि and Brahma too, तं द्विजम् to that brahmin, समीक्ष्य seeing, ननन्द rejoiced, सुस्वागतम् इति welcome to you, उवाच ह spoke.

40006627.author: Translation
40006627.content: Sarabhanga, performer of sacred deeds, saw Brahma with his followers৷৷ Brahma also seeing Sarabhanga, the best among the brahmins,  welcomed him gladly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
